objective: Align dsh_imagestudio to new docs 00/01/02/03 so the next executable slice is acceptance-ready for red lines plus the three core surfaces: ordinary generate (cancel, elapsed seconds, real pixel ratios), first-class built-in video on the same job queue with raw URLs, and a canvas that wires text/image into a config node and generates. Prove with npm test and scripts/preview.mjs screenshots. Do not restore score-gated generation.
end_state: Preview on :3080 serves /imagestudio. No-skill generate works. Low score never disables 就这样出图. Generate shows elapsed seconds and a Cancel control that aborts the in-flight request. Mock PNGs match the selected aspect ratio within 1 percent and 1K/2K/4K differ in pixel area. History refills prompt/ratio/clarity/n after reload. Gallery lists added shots and dedupes by sha256. Video mode enqueues on the same job store, plays a mock with the upstream URL unchanged. Canvas: text->config wire supplies prompt, generate drops a result node to the right with the edge kept, three serial iterations succeed. Ecommerce preview endpoint does not call generate until confirm. npm test green.
non_goals: UI design mode, slice editor, undo-50, SVG pipeline
Agent web search and multi-model ask-which-model chat
Replacing preview.mjs with a full official dsh web binary in this slice
Re-introducing score or veto as a generate gate
Copying VisioWork or Nova frontend source

open_questions: Is 100-node 30fps required in this slice or only after T6 functional canvas works? Plan treats 100-node perf as deferred measurement.
Should official `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` be a hard gate? This host demos via preview.mjs; official chrome is best-effort via existing entry.js.
Video mock asset: keep a tiny bundled mp4 under packages/provider-mock or only an example.invalid URL plus a poster frame?
